releaseName: Invites arrive by email, and waitlist sign-ups confirm their address
summary: Pressing Invite now emails the person a link that opens sign-up with their code filled in, in their language; the operator still sees the code as a fallback. A new waitlist sign-up gets a link to confirm the address, and only confirmed people show on the operator's waitlist; existing entries stay listed. Sign-in pages and their emails follow the screen's language. The waitlist no longer lists someone whose invite was already redeemed, and the operator page refreshes its lists every 30 seconds and when you return to the tab.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. The run dialog can still offer Start when the day's runs are used (#2974).
